sources.name: march-sw
sources.annotationMethod: Fresh independent final-native per-cell alpha>=64 cap-only minimum Y and manually selected boot-sole-only maximum exclusive Y. Manually interpreted concealed pelvis-center X is projected to each separately measured supporting-sole Y as a 2D registration pivot, not reconstructed pelvis or verified physical ground. All four ROIs, roots, cap tops and spans were freshly selected and measured on final SHA. One rounded-half-up median reference height across the complete source; no per-phase scaling or pivot interpolation.
limitations: Acceptance binds only to final native SHA cbd83756f656a82abf57d9b00eebdb2ad02447a8365144d3ac11d6e79d2a603c and all four independently inspected cells for the local Gettysburg v16 opt-in.
Four discrete contact/passing illustrations are not continuous skeletal animation, proof of physical gait, historical marching drill or zero foot sliding.

Concealed pelvis/hips and thigh overlap, ankle/heel attachments, supporting-versus-swinging boot depth and exact anatomical identity remain model-assisted 2D interpretations. Pelvis-center X is manually estimated, approximately plus or minus10 native pixels.

Final-native cap-to-selected-supporting-sole spans are [440,437,443,440] pixels; one reference height440 retains6-pixel variation1.364%. Posture, camera/boot depth and body-framing variation are not separated or normalized.

Final builtin material/edge edits changed some framing and untargeted body/kit details relative to colored diagnostics. Geometric or pixel equivalence to those inputs is not claimed; all final measurements and roles were freshly inspected.

Targeted saturated red(r>=200,g/b<=90) and yellow(r/g>=200,b<=90) residues remain at alpha1to3; zero alpha>=8 or64 pixels meet those criteria. Maximum targeted residue alpha is3. This is not exhaustive fringe/color/alpha cleanup, and nonzero low-alpha residue remains untouched.

Gray kepi/jacket, tan trousers, dark leather boots, brown cross straps, dark waist pouches, tan back roll and shoulder bag preserve broad ConfederateA kit. Face/skeleton and exact manufactured equipment continuity are not established.
Model-assisted independent inspection; human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production and complete-family certification remain false.
Renderer temporal behavior, turn/action continuity, pause/checkpoint geometry, decoded/GPU/process residency, device performance and human usability remain separate checks.
sources.scope: Exact historical Gettysburg v16 local opt-in only; default, production, complete family, human, physical anatomy and historical drill approval remain false.
